final_claim: For fixed n, the factorial Gibbs/Ewens laws on partitions of [n] conditioned on k cycles admit a single explicit nested one-split coupling of every k; with weights w_j=1/(j-1), the elementary-symmetric conditional Bernoulli probabilities p_j(b) and shared sequential uniform variables yield an exact product formula Q_{n,r}(S,h) for every ordered adjacent cut-set transition S -> S union {h}, with prescribed weighted-subset marginals.
